people.name: Gilead
people.line: Father of Jephthah, a judge of Israel.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

translations.web: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.
translations.bsb: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor; he was the son of a prostitute, and Gilead was his father.
translations.kjv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
translations.asv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor, and he was the son of a harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
